name: Windows DNS v0 Resolver Inspection Adapter
description: Supported adapter mapping for Windows read-only DNS resolver inspection via PowerShell Get-DnsClientServerAddress. The Windows adapter directory beyond DNS v0 remains UNIMPLEMENTED by policy.

declared_capabilities.name: Windows DNS resolver inspection v0
declared_capabilities.description: Read-only Windows DNS resolver observation for the DNS explicit resolver invariant using Get-DnsClientServerAddress | Format-List.

notes: The adapter directory alone does not equal supported status. Only the DNS v0 capability is supported; rest is UNIMPLEMENTED.
